__NOTOC__
==Overview==
* Imperial treasury during this season announced by the Civil Service at 806 thrones and 4 crowns.
* The following has been donated to the Imperial treasury:
** 8 thrones donated to the Senate treasury by '''Imperatrix Lisabetta von Holberg''' after the Summer Solstice 382YE

==Administrative==
An administrative motion was raised by the civil service.
* The Civil Service would like the Senate to confirm whether the [[Arcane Architect]] can construct sinecures that provide vis, rather than only crystal mana. Motion Passed.

===Commissions===
A total of 12 [[commission|commissions]] were announced during the Summer Solstice: 9 standard commissions, and 3 wayleaves.

==Announcements==
* [[The_Throne#The_Hand_of_the_Chancellor|Hand of the Chancellor]] was exercised by [[Empress Lisabetta|Imperatrix Lisabetta]] to the amount of 212 Thrones.
* The Quartermaster General announced that the Imperial Guerdon for Summer 382 is to go to the following armies: Hounds of Glory, Quiet Step, Drakes
* The Quartermaster General announced that [[Resupply Imperial armies Summer 382YE|all armies]] would receive emergency resupply this season.
* The [[Keeper of the Breadbasket]] announced that the breadbasket shall be directed to support Imperial armies.
* The [[Advisor on the Vallorn]] announced plans to research the life and eventual final fate of the Noble Terran General Bryony. The one who wore the crystal crown, forged in the last runeforge with a schemata granted by Zakalwe, the Weapon-wise. The crown led Bryony to lead a crystal army leading to her epitaph of Commander of the Crystal Hope. The results were published [[General Bryony and the Crystal Crown|here]].
* The intention to [[The_Throne#Address_the_Empire|address the Empire]] was announced by [[Empress Lisabetta|Imperatrix Lisabetta]], but was later withdrawn.
* An announcement by Vilkas Blake, [[bearer of an Imperial Wayleave]], to [[Construct Prosperity of Afal]]
* An announcement by Silvio di Tassato, bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, to [[Construct the Thorned Rose]]
* An announcement by Edmundo, bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, to [[Construct Legacy of Wisdom]]
